issues.issue: Was the RAD's refusal to admit the new topography evidence reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: New articles and reports were relevant and corroborated his testimony on topography work; RAD wrongly excluded them.
issues.respondent_position: RAD reasonably found the evidence not relevant to the determinative facts (para 14).
issues.result_quote: I agree with the respondent that the RAD acted reasonably in assessing the admissibility of the new evidence

issues.issue: Does the RAD's conduct or wording raise a reasonable apprehension of bias?
issues.applicant_position: RAD had decided the appeal early and made unjustified accusations, showing bias.
issues.respondent_position: Allegations rest on impressions and assumptions; no reasonable apprehension of bias (para 23).
issues.result_quote: They do not raise any reasonable apprehension of bias.
